release_notes:
Bug fixes: services pricing UI, DHRU custom-field sync, admin mobile menu, buy-credits flat fee

Batch of admin/client bug fixes and UI polish, all verified locally and already
running on the live install.

Services & pricing
- Add a read-only COST PRICE column (before Price) to the IMEI/File services list
  (services.php) and the Server services list (serverservices.php), via the existing
  "Cost Price" label constant (BE_LBL_651, backfilled into the dutch/french/
  portuguese/swedish language packs). Reorder/re-width columns so headers don't wrap.
- Convert the Status column to the modern st-chip pill on serverservices.php and
  rtlservices.php (also fixes an unclosed <a> tag that misaligned those rows).
- API price-margin popup: after saving a margin, the Price value, the collapsible
  "Default + X" summary and the row now update live; below-cost prices show red and
  clear back to normal when raised above cost; the edited row auto-selects. Applies to
  apiservices.php and the service-edit collapse (services/srvrservices/rtlservice
  _tab_general.php, setpriceswithapi.js).
- userpackageprices.php: custom per-user prices now save when you edit a price (the
  row auto-selects on edit) and the save no longer builds a malformed statement.

DHRU custom-field synchronization
- New opt-in "Synchronize custom fields" toggle on the API sync tabs (IMEI/File/
  Server), shown only for DHRU APIs, so routine cost/price syncs no longer touch the
  order-form schema. (api_tab_sync/api_file_sync/api_server_sync.php, api.js, ajxapi.php,
  sync_dhru_*services.php)
- Field definitions are now per-API and case-sensitive: the upsert keys on
  (APIId, ServiceType, ApiFieldName BINARY), so two suppliers with a same-named field
  can't clobber one definition and manually-created admin fields are never overwritten.
  Also handles the {n,} regex quantifier for length validation. (functions.php)
- Schema (migrations/1.0.29.sql, db/template.sql): add tbl_gf_custom_fields.APIId and
  .RegExpr, add tbl_gf_custom_field_values.CFVOrderBy, and widen
  tbl_gf_supplier_services.RequiredParams to TEXT. These shipped as code earlier but
  their schema was never bundled into a release; consolidated here (idempotent).

"Get Cost Price From API" (package.php)
- Targeted DHRU fallback: try getimeiservicedetails, fall back to a cached
  imeiservicelist when a supplier rejects it, and surface supplier rate-limit errors as
  a toast instead of silently returning blank. (ajxcostprice.php, package.js)

Admin mobile menu
- The collapsed admin menu now floats fixed just below the header when opened, so it
  stays on screen after scrolling instead of rendering at the top of the page and
  requiring a scroll back up. (assets/css/fresh-admin.css)

Buy Credits — flat fee
- The client Buy Credits page (modern theme) now shows and adds the payment method's
  Flat Fee to the Total Amount, matching what the server already charges.
  (addcredits_gf.php, include/js/modules/addcredits.js)
